'''Morla Maalet''' was a small-time [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] when he met [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Qual'om Soach]]. As Soach's criminal empire expanded, Morla became Soach's personal [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], taking command of the ''[[Invisible Star]]''.
